abstract: We provide novel bounds on average treatment effects (on the treated) that are valid under an unconfoundedness assumption. Our bounds are designed to be robust in challenging situations, for example, when the conditioning variables take on a large number of different values in the observed sample, or when the overlap condition is violated. This robustness is achieved by only using limited "pooling" of information across observations. Namely, the bounds are constructed as sample averages over functions of the observed outcomes such that the contribution of each outcome only depends on the treatment status of a limited number of observations. No information pooling across observations leads to so-called "Manski bounds", while unlimited information pooling leads to standard inverse propensity score weighting. We explore the intermediate range between these two extremes and provide corresponding inference methods. We show in Monte Carlo experiments and through two empirical application that our bounds are indeed robust and informative in practice.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了在无混杂假设下有效的平均处理效应（对受处理者）的新界限。这些界限旨在应对挑战性情境，例如当条件变量在观测样本中取大量不同值时，或当重叠条件被违反时，仍保持稳健性。这种稳健性通过仅利用观测间有限的“信息汇集”实现。具体而言，界限构建为观测结果函数的样本平均值，使得每个结果的贡献仅依赖于有限数量观测的处理状态。无信息汇集导致所谓的“曼斯基界限”，而无限制信息汇集则导致标准的逆倾向得分加权。我们探索了这两个极端之间的中间范围，并提供了相应的推断方法。通过蒙特卡洛实验和两个实证应用，我们展示了这些界限在实践中确实稳健且具有信息量。

abstract: We unpack the impact of expansions in ethanol production—as measured by proximity to newly constructed ethanol plants and capacity expansions—on farmland values using land transaction data from Kansas in combination with modern causal inference techniques. We first show that Two‐Way Fixed Effects (TWFE) estimation with data aggregated to the county and township level leads to an average land value effect ranging from 4% to 9% for parcels located within 50 km of an ethanol plant. However, using a modern difference‐in‐difference estimator, we find no evidence of a statistically significant effect on farmland values. Furthermore, our analysis reveals no indication that land value proximity premiums rose following the 2005 Energy Policy Act. We find evidence that the average treatment effect detected by conventional TWFE is largely driven by land transactions in the proximity of ethanol plants that were established prior to the 2005 Energy Policy Act. Proximity to ethanol plants established after the 2005 Energy Policy Act has a smaller and less robust effect on land values.
abstract_zh: 我们利用堪萨斯州的土地交易数据，结合现代因果推断技术，揭示了乙醇产量扩张（以新建乙醇工厂及产能扩张的邻近程度衡量）对农田价值的影响。首先，将数据汇总至县和乡镇层面后，采用双向固定效应（TWFE）估计发现，位于乙醇工厂50公里范围内的地块，其土地价值平均影响幅度在4%至9%之间。然而，使用现代双重差分估计器后，我们未发现乙醇工厂对农田价值具有统计上显著影响的证据。此外，分析表明，2005年《能源政策法案》实施后，土地价值并未因邻近乙醇工厂而出现溢价上升的迹象。我们找到证据表明，传统TWFE方法检测到的平均处理效应主要源于2005年《能源政策法案》之前已建立的乙醇工厂周边土地交易。而2005年《能源政策法案》之后建立的乙醇工厂，其邻近性对土地价值的影响较小且稳健性较弱。
title: Unpacking the Farmland Capitalization Effect of Ethanol Establishment
title_zh: 乙醇设施对农地资本化效应的解析

abstract: Repurposing agricultural public resources toward higher‐return incentives and investments can help transform agri‐food systems. This is important for low‐income countries, especially in sub‐Saharan Africa, where limited budgets restrict options for boosting agricultural spending. We demonstrate how, within a tight budget envelope, opportunities exist to achieve better agricultural transformation outcomes. To this end, we developed the policy optimization modelling tool, PolOpT, which combines a multicriteria decision‐making technique and a recursive‐dynamic computable general equilibrium model. We applied it with datasets for six sub‐Saharan African countries, including hundreds of estimated parameters that transmit the effect of policy measures onto agricultural productivity. The approach demonstrates that reallocating agricultural public expenditure across policy measures in these countries can potentially boost agri‐food output by several percentage points, create almost a million off‐farm jobs in rural areas, lift almost 3 million people out of poverty and allow 16 million people more to afford a healthy diet—all without extra funding.
abstract_zh: 将农业公共资源重新配置到更高回报的激励措施和投资领域，有助于推动农业食品体系转型。这对低收入国家尤为重要，尤其是撒哈拉以南非洲地区，这些国家有限的预算制约了农业支出增长的选择空间。我们证明，在预算约束范围内，仍存在实现更优农业转型成果的机遇。为此，我们开发了政策优化建模工具PolOpT，该工具融合了多准则决策技术与递归动态可计算一般均衡模型。我们利用六个撒哈拉以南非洲国家的数据集（包含数百个反映政策措施对农业生产率传导效应的估计参数）进行了应用分析。研究结果表明，在这些国家间重新配置农业公共支出，可在不增加额外资金的情况下，使农业食品产出提升数个百分点，在农村地区创造近百万非农就业岗位，帮助近300万人摆脱贫困，并使1600万人能够负担健康膳食。
title: Repurposing Agricultural Budgets With Multiple Objectives and Fiscal Constraints: A Multicriteria Decision‐Making Policy Tool Applied to Sub‐Saharan African Countries
title_zh: 多重目标与财政约束下的农业预算重新配置：应用于撒哈拉以南非洲国家的多准则决策政策工具

abstract: This paper quantifies the economy‐wide consequences of two independent global stress‐tests in livestock production. The first assesses the effects of phasing out antimicrobial growth promoters (AGPs), and the second evaluates the long‐term impacts of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) progression. We use a sequential, one‐way modelling framework combining a global partial equilibrium (PE) model and a global computable general equilibrium (CGE) model to trace how scenario‐defined shocks in livestock production propagate through world agricultural markets and the wider economy. The highest‐impact AGPs phase‐out scenario results in cumulative global livestock production losses, valued at constant 2021–2023 prices, of roughly USD 53 billion over 2025–2040, with annual deviations that peak in the mid‐2020s and then decline as output converges along scenario‐defined recovery paths. In contrast, the highest‐impact AMR scenario produces persistent and compounding reductions by construction, with cumulative production losses of about USD 318 billion by 2040, while cumulative economy‐wide welfare losses in this high‐impact case reach approximately USD 1.25 trillion, concentrated mainly in upper–middle‐income countries. Results are scenario dependent by construction and represent indicative orders of magnitude rather than forecasts. The baseline implicitly reflects prevailing levels of AGPs and AMR embedded in historical production trends. The study provides a framework for quantifying the production effects of antimicrobial use (AMU) and their economy‐wide spillovers, highlighting the asymmetric timing of the economic costs of action and inaction under the imposed scenario structure.
abstract_zh: 本文量化了畜牧业生产中两项独立全球压力测试对整体经济的影响。第一项评估了逐步淘汰抗生素生长促进剂（AGPs）的效应，第二项评估了抗生素耐药性（AMR）持续发展的长期影响。我们采用序贯单向建模框架，结合全球局部均衡（PE）模型与全球可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型，追踪情景设定的畜牧业生产冲击如何通过世界农产品市场及更广泛的经济体系传导。在影响最大的AGPs淘汰情景下，以2021-2023年不变价格计算，2025-2040年间全球畜牧业累计产量损失约为530亿美元，年度偏离值在2020年代中期达到峰值，随后随产出沿情景设定的恢复路径收敛而下降。相比之下，影响最大的AMR情景因设定机制产生持续且叠加的减产效应，至2040年累计产量损失约达3180亿美元，而该高影响情景下的累计经济福利损失约为1.25万亿美元，主要集中于中高收入国家。研究结果本质上具有情景依赖性，仅代表指示性量级而非预测值。基准情景隐含地反映了历史生产趋势中固有的AGPs与AMR水平。本研究为量化抗生素使用（AMU）的生产效应及其经济溢出提供了分析框架，揭示了在既定情景结构下，采取行动与不采取行动所产生经济成本在时间维度上的非对称性。
title: Antimicrobial Use in Livestock: The Economic Cost of Action or Inaction
title_zh: 畜牧业中抗生素的使用：行动或不行动的经济成本

abstract: Regular exercise offers well‐documented health benefits, and mobile applications are increasingly used to promote physical activity. In this study, we conduct a large‐scale randomized controlled trial with 20,187 users of the WeWard app in France to evaluate the effectiveness of different message framings and intervention durations on app engagement and walking behaviour. Participants were randomly assigned to receive one of three types of messages, each leveraging distinct behavioural features such as peer comparison, self‐comparison or a generic reminder, over a period of one or three weeks. Our results show that peer‐comparison messages positively influence the extensive margin of app utilization. However, despite these increases in app usage, neither type of message led to a significant increase in the number of steps walked. These findings highlight the limitations of relying on engagement metrics alone when evaluating app‐based interventions aimed at behaviour change.
abstract_zh: 规律运动对健康有明确益处，而移动应用程序正越来越多地被用于促进体育活动。本研究在法国WeWard应用的20,187名用户中开展大规模随机对照试验，评估不同信息框架和干预时长对应用参与度及步行行为的影响。参与者被随机分配接收三种类型的信息（分别利用同伴比较、自我比较或通用提醒等不同行为特征），干预周期为一周或三周。结果显示，同伴比较信息对应用使用的广延边际产生正向影响。然而，尽管应用使用频率有所提升，但各类信息均未显著增加步行步数。这些发现揭示了在评估基于应用的行为改变干预措施时，仅依赖参与度指标的局限性。
title: Step into action: how reminders shape engagement in fitness apps
title_zh: 步入行动：提醒如何塑造健身应用中的用户参与度

abstract: I propose a dynamic equilibrium model of rental markets that endogenously gives rise to defaults on rents and evictions. In the model, eviction protections make it harder to evict delinquent renters, but higher default costs to landlords increase equilibrium rents. I quantify the model using micro data on evictions, rents, and homelessness. I find that stronger eviction protections exacerbate housing insecurity and lower welfare. The key empirical driver of this result is the persistent nature of risk underlying rent delinquencies. Rental assistance reduces housing insecurity and improves welfare because it lowers the likelihood that renters default ex ante.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个内生产生租金违约与驱逐现象的租赁市场动态均衡模型。模型中，驱逐保护政策提高了驱逐违约租户的难度，但房东承担的更高违约成本会推高均衡租金。我利用关于驱逐、租金和无家可归的微观数据对模型进行量化分析，发现强化驱逐保护会加剧住房不安全并降低社会福利。这一结果的关键实证驱动因素在于租金违约风险的持续性特征。租金援助通过降低租户事前违约概率，有效缓解住房不安全并提升社会福利。
title: The Equilibrium Effects of Eviction Policies

abstract: Congressional candidates simultaneously seek votes from local residents and money from partisan potential donors who live across the United States. Ad targeting allows political candidates an inexpensive way not only to reach this dispersed partisan audience but also to deliver messages tailored to donors, whose preferences are more extreme than voters’. Using data on geographically-targeted Facebook ads, I find that the national ads of Democratic and Republican candidates have less issue overlap — and are more extreme — than their local, voter-targeted ads. Candidates’ ability to direct tailored, extreme communication to receptive audiences via targeted ads facilitates divergent political speech.
abstract_zh: 国会议员候选人在争取本地居民选票的同时，也寻求来自全美各地党派潜在捐赠者的资金支持。广告定向投放为政治候选人提供了一种低成本的方式，不仅能够触达分散的党派受众，还能向偏好比选民更为极端的捐赠者传递定制化信息。利用地理定向的Facebook广告数据，我发现民主党和共和党候选人的全国性广告在议题重叠度上低于其面向本地选民的广告，且内容更为极端。候选人通过定向广告向接受度高的受众传达定制化、极端化的政治言论，这一能力促进了政治话语的分化。
title: Two-faced on facebook: Ad tailoring in U.S. house campaigns
title_zh: 脸谱网上的两面性：美国众议院竞选中的广告定制

abstract: We study rainmaking as an instrumental religious belief. We present a model in which a religious leader tries to persuade people to believe. Praying for rain can persuade only where the hazard of rainfall during a dry spell is increasing over time, so that prayer is most likely to succeed when people most want rain. We present evidence from prayers for rain in Murcia, Spain, where the hazard rate is increasing, that the church’s prayers for rain predict rainfall over two centuries. To generalize this finding, we gather an original data set of whether ethnic groups around the world traditionally prayed for rain. We find that ethnic groups facing an increasing rainfall hazard are 47% more likely to pray for rain, consistent with our model’s prediction that societies are more likely to pray for rain where prayer is persuasive.
abstract_zh: 我们研究求雨作为一种工具性宗教信仰。我们构建了一个模型，其中宗教领袖试图说服人们相信求雨的有效性。只有当干旱期内降雨风险随时间递增时，求雨祈祷才具有说服力——这意味着祈祷最可能在人们最渴望降雨时成功。我们以西班牙穆尔西亚地区的求雨祈祷为证据，该地区降雨风险率呈递增趋势，发现教堂的求雨祈祷在两个世纪中持续预测了实际降雨。为推广这一发现，我们收集了全球各民族是否传统上举行求雨祈祷的原始数据集。研究发现，面临递增降雨风险的民族举行求雨祈祷的可能性高出47%，这与模型预测一致：在祈祷更具说服力的社会中，人们更可能进行求雨祈祷。
title: Praying for Rain

abstract: Discrete choice data allow researchers to recover differences in utilities, but these differences may not suffice to identify policy-relevant counterfactuals of interest. In fact, in the case of dynamic discrete choice models, only a narrow set of counterfactuals are point-identified. In this paper, we explore how much one can learn about counterfactual outcomes of interest within this framework. We focus on the partial identification of counterfactuals, while allowing for (mild) model restrictions that can gradually shrink the identified set. We derive bounds for low-dimensional objects (such as average welfare) as arguments of optimization programmes, along with a uniformly valid inference procedure. Furthermore, we develop new and tractable computational tools and algorithms suitable for dealing with high-dimensional problems like this. Finally, we illustrate in Monte Carlos, as well as an empirical exercise of firms’ export decisions, the informativeness of the identified sets, and we assess the impact of (common) model restrictions on results.
abstract_zh: 离散选择数据使研究者能够恢复效用差异，但这些差异可能不足以识别政策相关的反事实结果。事实上，在动态离散选择模型中，仅有一小部分反事实结果能被点识别。本文探讨了在此框架下，我们能对感兴趣的反事实结果了解到何种程度。我们聚焦于反事实的部分识别，同时允许（温和的）模型约束逐步缩小识别集。我们推导了低维对象（如平均福利）作为优化问题参数的边界，并提供了统一有效的推断方法。此外，我们开发了适用于处理此类高维问题的新型可计算工具与算法。最后，通过蒙特卡洛模拟以及企业出口决策的实证研究，我们展示了识别集的信息量，并评估了（常见）模型约束对结果的影响。
title: Counterfactual Analysis for Structural Dynamic Discrete Choice Models
title_zh: 结构动态离散选择模型的反事实分析

abstract: An agent samples projects over time, observing quality for each, while a principal can select at most one. The principal values quality, whereas the agent only wants a project chosen. Transfers are unavailable, but the principal can verify quality by paying a cost. We fully characterize the dynamics of verification by determining optimal mechanisms for this problem. With a low verification cost and a long horizon, the optimal mechanism involves a deterministic selection rule that initially discriminates on quality but chooses a project irrespective of its quality at a deadline. Verification occurs with an intermediate probability before the deadline, declining over time. We show how these conclusions change if the verification cost is high or the horizon is short, and under certain forms of imperfect commitment. Our analysis provides guidelines on how dynamics interact with the benefits of verification.
abstract_zh: 代理人随时间推移对项目进行抽样，并观察每个项目的质量，而委托人最多只能选择一个项目。委托人重视项目质量，而代理人只希望项目被选中。虽然无法进行转移支付，但委托人可以通过支付成本来验证质量。我们通过确定该问题的最优机制，全面刻画了验证的动态特征。在验证成本较低且时间跨度较长的情况下，最优机制包含一个确定性选择规则：该规则最初根据质量进行区分，但在截止日期前会忽略质量选择项目。验证行为在截止日期前以中等概率发生，且随时间推移而递减。我们展示了当验证成本较高或时间跨度较短时，以及在特定形式的不完全承诺条件下，这些结论如何发生变化。我们的分析为动态因素如何与验证收益相互作用提供了指导原则。
title: The Dynamics of Verification when Searching for Quality
title_zh: 质量搜寻中的验证动态

abstract: Online instruction holds the promise of expanding access to education for disadvantaged groups, yet it often deepens existing performance gaps. This study examines its impact on high-stakes exam outcomes, focusing on mechanisms driving differential effects for minority students. We leverage rich administrative data on students from five consecutive cohorts in 31 Israeli vocational colleges and the abrupt transition to online instruction during the COVID-19 pandemic. A key advantage of our setting is that exams were held in-person and graded centrally, ensuring comparability to pre-pandemic performance. Using a difference-in-differences design that compares outcomes within students and across cohorts, we find significant declines in both exam attendance and demonstrated knowledge following the switch to online instruction. These effects are not explained by local infection rates or childcare responsibilities, and are especially pronounced among Arabic-speaking minority students, regardless of their socioeconomic status. Drawing on variation in internet infrastructure, residential crowdedness, language of instruction, and prior academic performance, we show that poor internet access is a central mechanism underlying the adverse effects among minority students. For majority-group students, negative effects are concentrated among weaker students, suggesting widening disparities within the majority group. For minority students, the difference by prior achievement is not statistically significant, and if anything, the drop is larger for higher achievers.
abstract_zh: 在线教学有望扩大弱势群体接受教育的机会，然而它往往加剧了现有的成绩差距。本研究考察了在线教学对高风险考试结果的影响，重点关注驱动少数族裔学生差异化效应的机制。我们利用了来自以色列31所职业学院连续五届学生的大量行政数据，以及COVID-19疫情期间向在线教学的突然转变。我们研究设置的一个关键优势在于，考试以线下形式进行并由中央统一评分，确保了与疫情前成绩的可比性。采用双重差分设计，比较学生内部及不同队列之间的结果，我们发现转向在线教学后，考试出勤率和所展示的知识水平均显著下降。这些效应无法由当地感染率或育儿责任解释，并且在阿拉伯语少数族裔学生中尤为突出，无论其社会经济地位如何。利用互联网基础设施、居住拥挤程度、教学语言及先前学业成绩的差异，我们表明互联网接入不畅是少数族裔学生遭受不利影响的核心机制。对于多数群体学生，负面效应集中在学业较弱的学生中，表明多数群体内部差距在扩大。对于少数族裔学生，按先前学业成绩划分的差异在统计上不显著，甚至可以说，高成就者的下降幅度更大。
title: Disconnected: The unequal impact of online learning on minority students
